– expected capital required for our operations and development opportunities for our properties

– our ability to transition our real estate business into an asset-light real estate asset management platform on the time frame anticipated or at all, including our ability to raise third-party capital on terms that are favorable to us or at all

HHC also intends to raise third-party capital to fund future development, with it earning development, asset management, and performance fees, including as general partner of new real estate funds or other third-party capital vehicles.
Other than our condominium properties, most of the properties and projects in this segment do not generate revenues.

If we decide to redevelop or develop a Strategic Developments asset, we expect that with the exception of the residential portion of our condominium projects, upon completion of development, the asset would likely be reclassified to Operating Assets when the asset is placed in service and NOI would become a meaningful measure of its operating performance.
The following provides further detail for our under-construction and pre-development condominium projects as of September 30, 2026:

At its 2026 annual meeting of stockholders, held on September 30, 2026, HHH announced plans to accelerate its transformation into a diversified holding company by monetizing a substantial portion of its real estate assets, transitioning us into an asset-light real estate asset management platform, and redeploying the resulting proceeds primarily into Vantage, HHH’s specialty insurance and reinsurance subsidiary.
We may be unable to monetize our real estate assets at the values, on the terms, or within the time frame anticipated.

HHH’s plans to monetize our real estate assets are in their early stages, and as of the date of this Quarterly Report, neither we nor HHH has entered into definitive agreements for any transactions related to these plans.
If the value of any such assets is lower than we expect, we may be unable to monetize those assets on favorable terms or at all.

HHH’s plans to monetize our real estate assets and redeploy the proceeds into Vantage will significantly change our business, including by transitioning us to an asset-light real estate asset management platform and reducing the assets and cash flows available to us.

Following the sale of interests in our assets, we will hold minority interests in those assets, our ability to retain operational control will depend on contractual arrangements with our partners, and our future development activities will depend on our ability to raise third-party capital.

In addition, to the extent permitted by the indentures governing our senior unsecured notes and our other debt agreements, HHH expects that the proceeds of these transactions will be distributed to HHH and redeployed primarily into Vantage.
